subject: DPIA evidence & audit access request — onboarding checklist and logs
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: compliance@clearwaterhealth.com
Date: Mon, 9 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPIA evidence request & audit access — onboarding

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our security onboarding and DPIA assessment for vendors processing health-adjacent telemetry, our privacy team needs the following evidence to complete our review:

- Art. 28 / Art. 30 processing records or a template export
- A signed statement of subprocessor inventory and current subprocessors in scope
- A short sample of runtime telemetry: KV cache access logs and a 1-hour serving trace (redacted) to validate retention controls
- Confirmation of audit access (remote read-only session or snapshots) and any constraints on time ranges we can request
- Confirmation of encryption at rest for model artifacts and whether keys are customer-managed

We are trying to close the DPIA in the next two weeks; can you confirm what we can get by 2027-05-16 and whether a remote-review window can be scheduled (we prefer 2027-05-18 or 2027-05-19 morning ET).

Also, please confirm whether you require an access agreement or POA before we schedule remote sessions.

Thanks — I can loop in our procurement if a DocuSign is needed.

Best,
Olivia Grant
Director, Vendor Risk & Privacy
Clearwater Health
olivia.grant@clearwaterhealth.com

Attachment: request_summary_clearwater_20270509.pdf (stub)

Subject: Re: DPIA evidence request & audit access — onboarding

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. We can support this assessment; below is a proposed mutual action plan and what we can deliver by 2027-05-16.

Proposed next steps:
1) We will provide a Redacted Evidence Packet by 2027-05-16: Art.28/30 template export, subprocessor inventory CSV, SOC2 letter stub, and a short KV cache log sample.
2) Marcus will produce the serving trace redacted for PII and we can provide a timeboxed read-only session for live review on 2027-05-18 (10:00 ET) if that works for you.
3) If Clearwater requires a formal access agreement, please send the DocuSign link and we will have legal review it same-day.

Attachments I am sharing now (stubs):
- redwood_evidence_checklist_v2.pdf — our internal checklist mapped to your request
- mutual-action-plan_clearwater_v1.docx — draft timeline and responsibilities

Notes on scope and limitations:
- Logs will be redacted for any customer payload and internal debug tokens; we will provide synthetic IDs and sampling to maintain confidentiality.
- Encryption: model artifacts are encrypted at rest; some enterprise customers can opt for customer-managed keys — we can note current config for your prospective deployment.

Marcus and Mina — can you confirm feasibility for the samples and expected delivery ETA?

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

On Mon, May 9, 2027 at 10:03 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Marcus and Mina — can you confirm feasibility for the samples and expected delivery ETA?

Hi all — quick technical note: we can produce the 1-hour serving trace and a KV cache log sample with the following constraints:
- Time range: choose any contiguous 1-hour window in UTC; I recommend 2027-05-02T14:00:00Z to 2027-05-02T15:00:00Z as a representative sample
- Redaction: we will remove message payloads and replace customer identifiers with synthetic IDs; requesters will receive a short redaction manifest describing transformations
- Format: KV cache sample will be a JSONL export (kvcache-log-sample-202705.jsonl), serving trace will be a compressed stub (serving-trace-1hr-stub.tar.gz) with a pointer file describing fields

I will generate the sample and aim to deliver by 2027-05-15 COB for review. For the remote read-only session we will provide a constrained role in our console (log-only access) and session recording can be enabled if required.

Marcus
Principal SRE, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
